      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Resolves confusing logging configuration behavior where -loglevel alone would silently fail without -debug. Within the utilities rubric, addressing confusing logging options is explicitly valued, though the issue is not critical to node operation and is reasonably deferrable."
